title: Reload still shows the sign-in page when already signed in
description:
**Reported still broken 2026-09-08, after #339.**

Symptom, from the human: log in, reload `dev.chattic.us`, the sign-in page appears again. Pressing **Sign in with Google** returns you signed in **without re-entering credentials**.

That last detail is the diagnostic. The identity provider session is alive and valid — the app just is not using it on mount. So this is not a login problem, it is a session-restore problem.

## What is already correct

`membership-context.tsx` does restore on mount: a `useEffect` calls `refreshSession()` → `getVerifiedSession()` → `getUserManager().getUser()`. That path exists and #339 was right to add it. So the fix is in the code, and something downstream of it is returning nothing usable.

Two candidates, and runtime is needed to tell them apart: `getUser()` returns null, or `verifiedSessionFromUser` rejects because `verifyIdTokenClaims` throws or returns falsy. **Check that first** — one `console` reading of both in the browser settles it in a minute and prevents guessing.

**Also confirm the development web deploy for #339 actually landed before concluding.** A sign-in prompt against the old build proves nothing.

## Two config problems that are definite regardless

Both in `buildUserManagerSettings` (`web/lib/auth.ts`), both worth fixing whatever the immediate cause turns out to be.

### 1. No refresh token, so `automaticSilentRenew` is inert

```ts
scope: "openid email profile",
automaticSilentRenew: true,
```

Without **`offline_access`**, Cognito does not issue a refresh token, so there is nothing for silent renew to renew with. The flag is set and cannot do anything.

**Consequence beyond this bug:** once the `id_token` expires — typically an hour — the user is signed out with no silent recovery. Fixing the reload path alone leaves sessions dying hourly.

### 2. `prompt: "select_account"` is global, which also blocks iframe silent renew

```ts
extraQueryParams: { identity_provider: "Google", prompt: "select_account" },
```

The stated requirement was to show the account chooser **after the user clicks Sign out**. This applies it to *every* authorization request.

Silent renew via hidden iframe requires `prompt=none`; an account chooser cannot render in a hidden iframe, so that path fails too. Between this and the missing `offline_access`, **both** silent-renew mechanisms are closed off.

Apply `select_account` to the post-signout sign-in only, not to the manager's global settings.

## Suggested fix

1. Instrument first — is `getUser()` null, or is claim verification rejecting? Do not guess.
2. Add `offline_access` to `scope` so a refresh token exists.
3. Move `prompt: "select_account"` out of global settings onto the post-signout path.
4. On mount, if the stored user is absent or fails verification, attempt `signinSilent()` before falling back to the sign-in panel. Given the IdP session is demonstrably valid — clicking the button proves it — this is what turns a visible sign-in into an invisible one.

## Done when

Reloading `/chat` while signed in keeps you signed in with no button press, a session survives past `id_token` expiry without a visible prompt, and clicking **Sign out** still shows the account chooser on the next sign-in.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Cognito does not use the OIDC offline_access scope. The SPA client already has refreshTokenValidity 30 days and authorization-code grant; Cognito issues a refresh token with openid. Allowed OAuth scopes in infra/lib/auth-stack.ts are only openid/email/profile. Adding offline_access to scope without that CDK list is invalid_scope (or a no-op). Planner must not add it. Confirm the token response already includes refresh_token; if oidc-client-ts is not using it, that is a library setting, not a missing scope.

getVerifiedSession calls verifyIdTokenClaims, which throws on exp. An expired id_token in localStorage therefore becomes an error, not a silent renew. Mount path must catch that and signinSilent() before the sign-in panel.

Instrument getUser vs claim verify only after a73f21 lands a web deploy that includes #339. Live dev.chattic.us is still 4ba8bc2.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Plan sent back. Do not add offline_access to the SPA scope or to CDK AllowedOAuthScopes. Cognito does not use that OIDC scope; the client already issues a refresh token on authorization-code + openid (refreshTokenValidity 30 days). Adding it is invalid_scope or a dual path ("try custom scope, if Cognito rejects fall back") — both forbidden.

Also: do not block this PR on a73f21. Code in parallel; live instrument only after that deploy. Do not merge console.debug. getVerifiedSession/verifiedSessionFromUser throws on exp — restore must catch that and signinSilent before the sign-in panel. Revise the plan, then stop. No code.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Revised plan approved with amendments. Authorizing Composer 2.5 to create /tmp/chatticus-5e4c9a-session-restore on feat/5e4c9a-session-restore from origin/develop.

Amendments: (1) Update auth-stack-harness CallbackURLs — tests exact-match the array, not only auth-stack.ts. (2) Silent callback page must call signinSilentCallback only — never router.replace into /chat (that navigates the iframe). (3) CloudFront SPA rewrite already maps any extensionless path to index.html; add a test for /auth/silent-callback, do not re-hardcode an auth-path allowlist. (4) AuthStack deploy is required for the iframe path; refresh-token renew is the customer DoD after localStorage. Google-in-iframe may fail in Chrome; that is not a merge blocker if expired-id_token + refresh restores.
